verdicts.title: Between Coherent and Constructible Local Langlands Correspondences
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Refined forms of the local Langlands correspondence seek to relate representations of reductive groups over local fields with sheaves on stacks of Langlands parameters. But what kind of sheaves? Conjectures in the spirit of Kazhdan-Lusztig theory (due to Vogan and Soergel) describe representations of a group and its pure inner forms with fixed central character in terms of constructible sheaves. verdicts.title: Langlands Program, Trace Formulas, and their Geometrization
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The Langlands Program relates Galois representations and automorphic representations of reductive algebraic groups.
